scope: Primary-source documentation review for a separate game-performance research ranking; no production or billing changes

recommendation.start: Use public ESPN-derived per-game boxscore files for an offline performance prototype, with source freshness and coverage checked first. Keep it separate from SOR and predictive strength until validated.
recommendation.optionalCfbdUpgrade: A single privately cached year-wide advanced-game request is a documented free-tier path to per-game PPA, success rate and explosiveness. Verify one response against expected completed-game coverage before enabling it weekly.
recommendation.noNewUserCredentialExpected: Existing CFBD secret is sufficient for the documented free endpoints; this review did not access it. No paid plan is needed for ordinary completed-game stats.
recommendation.publicOutputs: Publish derived rankings, explanations and provenance/hash metadata. Keep raw CFBD response bodies and equivalent bulk normalized tables private.

freeTier.known: Official tier page includes historical data, game/season team stats and advanced EPA/PPA metrics. Live play-by-play is a separate paid feature.

coverage.knownLimit: These ranges do not guarantee every game, subdivision or field. Current-season data can lag; missing values are not zeros.

endpoints.accessEvidence: Official stats controller uses standard quota middleware and no paid-tier decorator; free tier explicitly includes advanced metrics.
endpoints.known: Year alone satisfies documented query selection; week/team/opponent optional. Contains offense/defense plays, drives, PPA, success rate, explosiveness and rushing-line metrics.
endpoints.uncertain: Not called: actual account entitlement, 2026 rows, null rates, full game coverage, payload size and production deployment/schema remain unverified.

endpoints.known: Bulk year query; team optional; startWeek/endWeek optional. Current controller defaults classification to FBS. Does not expose seasonType in this operation.
endpoints.uncertain: Aggregate alone cannot support game-by-game opponent adjustment or exact weekly backtests without dated inputs.

endpoints.known: Bulk year query, optional team/conference/week bounds. Current server and Python SDK use /stats/season; an older .NET documentation page uses /stats/season/team, so do not copy that outdated spelling.
endpoints.uncertain: Category availability and rates must be inspected in a controlled response; current controller has no seasonType parameter here.

endpoints.known: Year requires at least one of week/team/conference unless id selects a game. Do not assume year-only fetch returns a full season. Cache historical weeks and refresh recent completed weeks for corrections.
endpoints.uncertain: Week numbering/seasonType and FBS-FCS availability must be joined to the existing schedule; postseason is a separate scope.

endpoints.known: Year required; week/team/conference optional. No paid-tier decorator in current controller. More compact PPA-only alternative to advanced game stats, not necessarily an additional required request.
endpoints.uncertain: Provider PPA is a model-derived metric, not raw play observation. Capture source/method version where available.

endpoints.known: Year AND week required; optional team/offense/defense filters. Schema contains game/drive/play ids, down/distance, yards gained, clock/period, scores and ppa. Standard historical endpoint differs from paid live endpoint.
endpoints.uncertain: PPA may be absent and historical fields vary; raw play processing is substantially more work than consuming game-level efficiency.

endpoints.known: Official controller requires Patreon tier2. Unnecessary for Sunday completed-game updates; do not request or attempt to bypass the tier.

terms.known: Private caching, analysis/model training, derived rankings and reasonable product display are allowed. Bulk raw-data publication and public raw-response mirrors are prohibited; normalized copies retaining the same informational content are also API Data. API keys must remain server-side. Attribution is appreciated, not required. Quota is shared with CBBD.
terms.implementation: Temporary private job caches may feed hashes and derived outputs. Public GitHub artifact allowlists should exclude provider-response and full normalized-season payloads.

publicAlternatives.name: SportsDataverse ESPN-derived team box files
publicAlternatives.authentication: No auth for GitHub release asset files; separate SportsDataverse hosted Data API requires bearer token.
publicAlternatives.known: One row per team per game. Public boxscore records allow an initial yards-per-play/turnover/special-teams research pass without consuming CFBD quota.
publicAlternatives.freshness: Release description read during this review reports last asset written2026-10-01. This is not proof of complete Nov6 coverage; inspect actual file game dates/ids and timestamps before current rankings.
publicAlternatives.uncertain: Individual game coverage, normalization correctness, current update lag and source-specific data rights require validation.

publicAlternatives.name: SportsDataverse ESPN-derived advanced game tables
publicAlternatives.authentication: No auth for GitHub release assets
publicAlternatives.known: Compact per-game advanced team data derived by the maintainer pipeline from ESPN; other tags expose drives, turnovers, special teams and situational data.
publicAlternatives.freshness: Release description says last asset written2026-10-01; inspect actual file cutoff.
publicAlternatives.uncertain: EPA/success definitions and model artifacts must be versioned. Do not mix this EPA with CFBD PPA as though they were interchangeable.

publicAlternatives.name: SportsDataverse ESPN-derived play-by-play
publicAlternatives.authentication: No auth for GitHub release assets
publicAlternatives.known: Public season files contain enriched EPA/WPA. Use espn_cfb_pbp, not the old committed cfbfastR-data/pbp tree frozen at2002-2021. Read individual needed seasons rather than downloading the full12.4GB release.
publicAlternatives.freshness: Release description says last asset written2026-10-01; check actual games/timestamps.
publicAlternatives.uncertain: Retrospectively rebuilt EPA may use later-trained models; not automatically valid for prospective prediction evaluation.

publicAlternatives.name: Direct public ESPN summary feeds
publicAlternatives.authentication: Public ESPN-derived pipeline captures unkeyed site/core API responses
publicAlternatives.known: Maintainer pipeline captures raw ESPN summaries and derives team-box extras from them; incremental per-game caching can fill freshness gaps.
publicAlternatives.uncertain: No official ESPN stability/support/usage guarantee was located here. A public endpoint is not a promise of unlimited requests or unrestricted redistribution. Treat schema as changeable; avoid repeated whole-season per-game polling.

licenseAndAttribution.known: cfbfastR and sportsdataverse-data repository software licenses are MIT. Preserve applicable copyright/license notices when reusing their software. This does not by itself establish rights to every underlying third-party sports datum, logo or model asset.
licenseAndAttribution.suggestedAttribution: Source: ESPN via SportsDataverse/cfbfastR; identify the specific release/tag, asset and transformation.
licenseAndAttribution.notEstablished: No separate blanket data redistribution license or ESPN SLA was established from the inspected documentation.

budgetEstimatesNotActualUse.assumptions: One successful bulk response per documented scope, cached locally/private. Retries, independent coverage probes, categories/calendar reads, additional subdivisions and other CFBD/CBBD users add calls. No per-visitor fetching. Recheck remaining monthly budget before any future authenticated backfill.

acceptanceBeforeUse: Match per-game stats to known completed-game ids and both team identities; report missing coverage rather than use zeros.
Capture source URL/query, retrieval time, effective data cutoff, schema/method version and checksums.
Separate raw observations from provider-modeled PPA/EPA and human-derived inputs; do not ingest polls, FPI, recruiting or prestige fields into earned performance.
Freeze feature definitions and training periods; check outcome/prediction leakage and subdivision coverage before presenting a new ranking as validated.
